description: This source file defines the 'GeneralSettings' SwiftUI View, which provides a configuration interface for the OpenClaw macOS application. It includes UI elements for toggling features, managing gateway connections, remote access, health checks, and related diagnostics.

classes.name: RemoteStatus
classes.description: An enum representing the status of remote gateway connection tests, with cases for idle, checking, success, and failure.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the current gateway environment status and updates the view state accordingly.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous test of the remote gateway connection and updates the remoteStatus state based on the result.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Locates the openclaw logs and opens them in the file viewer; shows alert if logs are not found.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Applies a newly discovered gateway to the application's settings and updates the current gateway selection.
